recognize_zh: 低倍皮膚切片可見真皮被一片淡染、較均質的浸潤取代，正常網狀膠原束被推擠，表皮大致正常；單看低倍只能提示真皮組織球浸潤，需高倍見泡沫狀組織球與 Touton 巨細胞才支持 Erdheim-Chester 病。
features: Two skin punch/wedge biopsies at scanning magnification
Unremarkable epidermis with preserved rete pattern
Dermis expanded by a diffuse, pale, hypercellular infiltrate replacing reticular collagen
Infiltrate extends into deep dermis around adnexal structures
Cellular detail not resolvable at this magnification
describe_en: Scanning-magnification sections of two skin biopsies show an intact epidermis overlying a dermis that is expanded by a diffuse, pale-staining infiltrate which effaces the normal reticular dermal collagen and surrounds adnexal structures, extending to the deep margin. Cytologic detail cannot be assessed at this magnification; higher power is required to confirm foamy histiocytes and Touton giant cells. In the clinical and radiologic context, the pattern is compatible with cutaneous involvement by Erdheim-Chester disease.

ddx.vs: Xanthomas contain foamy histiocytes but lack clonal BRAF V600E and are typically more superficial and not associated with systemic long-bone sclerosis.
JXG shares the CD68+/CD163+/CD1a- phenotype but presents as solitary lesions in children without systemic ECD features, and distinction may require clinical/radiologic correlation.
Morphea shows thickened hyalinized collagen with a sparse perivascular lymphoplasmacytic infiltrate rather than a histiocyte-rich infiltrate.
NXG shows zones of necrobiosis, bizarre giant cells, and cholesterol clefts and is associated with paraproteinemia.
